title: Google Cloud fraud defense, the next evolution of reCAPTCHA
summary: Google Cloud announces Fraud Defense, the next evolution of reCAPTCHA that provides enterprise-grade fraud protection using advanced ML algorithms to detect bot attacks, account takeover attempts, and fraudulent transactions across web and mobile applications.
problem_solved: Provides comprehensive fraud detection and bot protection for enterprises to prevent account takeover, credential stuffing, and transaction fraud.
why_valuable: Consolidates Google's decades of anti-fraud expertise from reCAPTCHA into an integrated enterprise security solution with real-time threat detection capabilities.
